skills.name: Dauntless Strike
skills.description: Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and briefly stunning targets in an area. Targets hit by the further part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

skills.name: Vengeance
skills.description:
Arlott charges at an enemy, dealing 135<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement).
If Arlott's target is <font color='#404495'>(Marked)</font>, this skill will deal double damage, immediately refresh its cooldown, and restore <font color='#D58E1F'>( +90% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit.)

skills.name: Final Slash
skills.description: Arlott cleaves in front of him, dealing 400<font color='#D58E1F'>( +80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to targets in the area while pushing them to the end of the AOE and briefly revealing their location.

skills.name: Demon Gaze
skills.description:
Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will <font color='#404495'>(Mark)</font> enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 8s.
The eye will also automatically <font color='#404495'>(Mark)</font> a nearby enemy hero in vision every 8s.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.des: Unique Passive - Armor Buster: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 40%.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate
items.des: Unique Passive - Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 6 extra Physical Attack and Magic Power and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Gain 15% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

synergy.name: Beatrix
synergy.tips: Combines high utility, excellent lane pressure, and perfect teamfight synergy with Beatrix.

counters.name: Phoveus
counters.tips: Arlott counters Fighters with relatively lower HP, such as Sun and Zilong. Arlott can deal high burst damage and has excellent chasing and control abilities, allowing him to quickly eliminate more fragile Fighters.

countered_by.name: X.Borg
countered_by.tips: Arlott is countered by tanky Fighters that can withstand lots of damage, like Thamuz and Fredrinn, because he lacks the burst to take them out quickly and will lose in a prolonged battle.
